result.conclusion: At fixed 1M additional dose, fresh-minus-replay preservation/transfer contrasts were Seed1 -10.126/+7.446 and Seed3 +10.402/-4.102 bb100; all conditional 95CIs include zero. Fresh own-root panel means were negative in all four cells; Seed3 transfer -19.122 CI[-37.844,-0.400]. No replicated fresh-only advantage, no severe-collapse gate, no external qualification. This is insufficient positive scaling evidence, not causal rejection of fresh-only learning at all scales.
result.decision: Do not promote fresh-only or automatically allocate 4M/Slumbot. Preserve all four endpoints and roots; complete fixed experiment without declaring goal success.
result.next_step: Zero-new-hand compute allocation review of retained lineage own-root multi-dose curves, opponent breadth and wall cost; choose sustained scale versus a mechanism-targeted change from evidence, not another arbitrary parameter sweep.
